ftb.guhs_guhpixel.title: &dGuhpixel
ftb.guhs_guhpixel.sub: The minigame server of the guhs. /lobby, Nyeg!
ftb.guhs_guhpixel.section.px_thuis: For Home: Guhcade, Guh Office & Guh Cinema
This chapter comes after &6The Super Compass&r in &dThe Guhmension&r: in the &dMinigames&r tab there, pick the &dGuh Internet Café "The Slow Connection"&r.

In the café guhs are asleep behind old beige computers. Walk through the big screen and you're standing in the lobby of &dGuhpixel&r: the minigame server of the guhs. After that &6/lobby&r, &6/hub&r and &6/l&r work everywhere.

Play the joke games, earn &6Guhpixel Coins&r (not an item: they are on your name) and buy things for your home with them: the Guhcade, the Guh Office and the Guh Cinema. The &dTravel Agency&r and the &dGuh Parkour&r are simply in the Guhmension. Nothing is locked: every quest ticks itself off as soon as you've done it, even if you did it before. The headings show what logically comes next. Tick this off and get chonking!
